scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship
eligibility: Above 80th percentile in Class 12; pursuing a regular degree course at a recognized institution; family income must not exceed ₹4.5 lakh per annum; Aadhaar-seeded bank account required
documents: Class 12/board result; income proof; Aadhaar; bank account details; other documents as required
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for first 3 years of graduation; ₹20,000 per annum at postgraduate level; ₹20,000 in 4th/5th year for eligible 5-year professional/integrated courses

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
eligibility: Resident of Punjab; applicant must be a widow; age above 40; must belong to a Below Poverty Line family
documents: Identity proof; husband's death certificate; residence/address proof; age proof; BPL card/related documents; bank passbook/account details; caste certificate if applicable
benefits: ₹300 per month for widows aged 40–79; ₹500 per month for widows aged 80 and above
